result.summary: The image shows a mobile food delivery app interface. The primary visual issue is a layout/clipping error in the bottom restaurant card.

issues.description: The bottom-most restaurant card (likely a pizza place) is cut off by the navigation bar, making it impossible to see the restaurant name, delivery time, or rating.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the bottom padding or margin of the main scroll view so that the last item is fully visible and not hidden behind the navigation menu.
